text:
maya: Heads-up — we're seeing an ECC error rate spike on the eu-west GPU fleet, intermittent kernel oops and a couple of node crashes. Noticing elevated corrected+uncorrected counts on p4d-type nodes.
liam: Which node IDs / AZs? Any impact to Dedicated customers yet?
sophie: Affected nodes: gpu-eu-03a, gpu-eu-07c, gpu-eu-11b (all in eu-west-1b/1c). No SLA hits reported yet but autoscaler is struggling to schedule heavy-gen pods.
ops-bot: alert: gpu-eu-07c ECC corrected errors @ 180/min, kernel OOPS logged, pod evictions started.
liam: Ok. Sophie — please cordon + drain the lowest-health nodes. Add them to maintenance group.
sophie: On it. Running: `kubectl cordon node/gpu-eu-07c && kubectl drain node/gpu-eu-07c --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=10m`
sophie: Also increasing pod disruption budget for gen services to allow controlled reschedule.
ravi: Suggest taking heavy generation routes out of eu-west and shifting to us-east until we stabilize. We should minimize cross-region latency for low-latency customers but for batch workloads we can failover.
alex: We can flip smart routing policy to prefer us-east for model-serving with `fallback_regions: ["us-east-1"]` and set max_cross_region_tokens to limit cost.
liam: How many nodes will we need in us-east to absorb peak? Estimate: +12 p4d-equivalents for 95th percentile.
alex: We have warm pool of 6 in us-east. Can spin on-demand for the rest — but spot availability might be flaky.
nicole: Heads-up from finance: spinning +12 on on-demand will add ~ $4.8k/day. If we push to reserved/burst commit it'll change the monthly burn.
liam: For now on-demand for 6-12 hours while we repair in eu-west. Nicole, approve temporary spend? Keep it to emergency window.
nicole: Approving short-term on-demand for up to 12 hours. Flag if we need >24h.
sophie: Drain progress: gpu-eu-07c drained ✅, gpu-eu-03a cordoned (drain in progress), gpu-eu-11b still reporting kernel panics, isolating.
ravi: Re-route heavy-gen traffic now? I can toggle rollout for 20% -> 100% to us-east over 10m.
liam: Do gradual 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 15m, watch tail latency and token cost.
ravi: Rolling now. Patch snippet:
```
PATCH /routing
{
  "policy": "latency_preference",
  "fallback_regions": ["us-east-1"],
  "gradual_shift": {"steps": [20,50,100], "interval_mins": 5}
}
```
ops-bot: deployment: routing-config v2.13 rolled to 20% @ 1754126892
maya: Observing increased token egress and cross-region latency ~40ms added for fallback path, but service latency for eu-west customers is stable.
liam: Hardware side — look at ECC logs. Are these corrected errors trending into uncorrected? If uncorrected we should RMA.
sophie: Some uncorrected errors showing on gpu-eu-11b. I've opened hardware ticket INC-17698 with vendor. RMA options: remote hot-swap (if spare blades in colo) ETA 6h, or full board ship ETA 48h.
alex: If hot-swap available, prefer that to minimize cross-region time. Can we move customer-critical pools off eu-west to avoid scheduled maintenance overlap?
maya: Yes. We'll maintain Dedicated customer allocation in eu-west for now by pinning to unaffected nodes. For customers who want strict locality we should notify.
liam: Notify SRE-runbooks and customer-success. Sophie — create a short status blurb for #customer-facing and include expected timeline/impact.
sophie: Drafting: "We are performing GPU node maintenance in eu-west, some workloads are being routed to us-east as a precaution. No data exposure. Expect intermittent capacity degradation for the next 6-12 hours. We'll update with ETA for hot-swap." will post in #customer-updates after review.
nicole: Also track cost delta and create a chargeback tag so we can attribute to incident budget.
ravi: After hot-swap we'll run `nvmlDeviceGetMemoryErrorCounter` checks and a 30m burn-in with model A to validate KV cache integrity.
maya: Action items:
- Sophie: finish drains and hardware ticket INC-17698, coordinate RMA/hot-swap (ETA 6h if spare blades) ✅
- Liam/Alex: scale us-east capacity + spin on-demand nodes, adjust autoscaler thresholds ✅
- Ravi: roll routing 20->100 and run validation workloads ✅
- Nicole: enable chargeback tag for incident spend ✅
- Maya: notify CS + update status message in 15m ✅

liam: If we see more nodes trending, prepare fallback to eu-central as secondary region.
ops-bot: notice: autoscaler launched 8 on-demand p4d-eq nodes in us-east @ 1754126938
maya: Thanks team — I'll monitor error rates and kernel logs. Ping me if any uncorrected ECC crosses threshold.
liam: Good work, keep updates short in this thread. We'll reconvene in 30m or sooner on escalation.
